proof: B=(I+K)^−1 exists, is injective positive self-adjoint contraction, dense range D(K), by coercivity, closedness and kernel/range orthogonality under CC.

Deterministic Gram–Schmidt of an enumerated dense family gives finite-rank P_n→I strongly. Compress B_n=P_nBP_n. Continuous factor identities follow from multiplicativity and measure uniqueness. μ_x({0})=0 for x in ranB by μ_Bz=b²μ_z, then all x by density plus measure-form Cauchy–Schwarz. This justifies the reciprocal pushforward E=b^−1−1 without adding a zero-endpoint atom.
